Root cause was a bad Codex transcript path assumption.

`attach` was resolving Codex sessions as flat files under `~/.codex/<session-id>.jsonl`, but your actual session exists in the dated sessions tree:
`~/.codex/sessions/2026/04/08/rollout-2026-04-08T10-43-48-019d6c43-1537-7343-9691-1f8cee04fe59.jsonl`.

I fixed Codex resolution in [codex.go](/Users/soph/Work/entire/devenv/cli/cmd/entire/cli/agent/codex/codex.go) so it now:
- uses `CODEX_HOME/sessions` as the base directory
- finds `rollout-...-<session-id>.jsonl` in the `YYYY/MM/DD` tree
- still preserves absolute-path handling from hooks

I also added regression coverage in [codex_test.go](/Users/soph/Work/entire/devenv/cli/cmd/entire/cli/agent/codex/codex_test.go) and an end-to-end attach test in [attach_test.go](/Users/soph/Work/entire/devenv/cli/cmd/entire/cli/attach_test.go).
